capabilities.description: Freeze a registered host dataset or explicitly selected declared source query into a fixed DataRef. Preserve actual rows and provenance; demo remains demo.

operation_id.description: Stable idempotency key for this exact snapshot

dataset_id.description: Existing dataset ID registered in host#datasets only. For a plugin receipt's dataset_id, use that plugin's declared SourceRef with input:{datasetId} and title instead of this shortcut.

usage.purpose: Freeze a registered host dataset or explicitly selected declared source query into a fixed DataRef. Preserve actual rows and provenance; demo remains demo.
usage.inputs: operation_id 固定采集；裸 dataset_id 仅指 host#datasets 中的宿主登记数据。MT5 等插件回执的 dataset_id 须选择其原数据来源 SourceRef，传 source+input:{datasetId:<原ID>}+title，不传顶层 dataset_id；两种形状互斥，source 使用来源目录返回的精确 providerId/revision/binding。provenance_kind 仅在来源缺失时补充；dependencies 为固定引用。
usage.outputs: data_snapshot 的 {ref,evidence,rowCount,columns,sample,provenance,receipt}；ref 可直接绑定报告。
prerequisites: sesame/data-access 已安装可用；已得到固定 DataRef 时无需再冻结。
limitations: 不生成数据或计算统计；demo 永远保留 demo。裸 dataset_id 不会跨来源搜索，也不会把插件数据登记到宿主；资源不存在时核对 ID 所属来源，不能猜换 ID、复制注册或伪造空数据。未登记文件可通过真实来源/计算能力生成数据成果。

capabilities.description: Write a unified editable report/1 scaffold. Prefer existing charts: line, bar, scatter, matrix, units, waterfall, dumbbell, strip, histogram, boxplot, ridgeline, violin, calendar, parallel, bump, lifecycle, treemap, threads, flow, network-circular, network-force, decision-tree, candlestick. Candlestick reuses the market workbench's default Lightweight Charts style. Read report-design/chart-catalog.md for fields and reportKit-only area/hbar/heatmap. All data uses fixed bindings.

summary.description: Main finding supported by the bound data

data_id.description: Exact binding ID to include in report_publish.data

chart_title.description: Chart title with scope and period

takeaway.description: The supported point this chart makes

source_note.description: Source, observation period, units and material limitations

x.description: Category or x-coordinate column; required by line/bar/scatter/matrix/units

y.description: Value or matrix row column; required by line/bar/scatter/matrix/units

items.description: Exact column name in the data

chart_options.description: Chart-specific field mappings and display options from report-design. Do not put data rows, callbacks or computed financial results here.

property.description: Extra chart data property, for example nodes

data_id.description: Fixed report data binding to read for that property

usage.purpose: Write an editable report/1 HTML scaffold with Sesame’s original typography, conclusion, numbered evidence and folded methods. Optional comparison, distribution, temporal and relationship charts use the same style. Read report-design for chart field mappings; all chart data comes from named fixed bindings.
usage.inputs: output_path 为工作区 HTML；data_id 是稍后 report_publish.data[].id，非 Artifact ID。title/summary/takeaway/source_note 说明结论与口径；kind 与 x/y/value/columns 映射固定数据列，复杂图读 report-design 对应资源。
usage.outputs: {path,bytes,runtime,runtimeRevision,binding,editable:true}；可编辑 HTML 已内联原版样式、reportKit 和图表代码。
prerequisites: sesame/workspace 可读写；数据列与单位已知。
limitations: 只生成文件，不发布、不计算金融统计、不证明渲染。图形参数冲突时修正具体字段映射，不填演示值补缺口。

capabilities.description: Write an editable prose-only report/1 document using the shared editorial layout. Preserve authored body HTML, including legitimate inline styles and offline interactions. No fabricated chart, data, publication or render claim.

body_html.description: Authored report body HTML. Escape prose before interpolating; inline offline styles/scripts remain subject to publish and runtime policy.

usage.purpose: Write an editable prose-only report/1 document using the shared editorial layout. Preserve authored body HTML, including legitimate inline styles and offline interactions. No fabricated chart, data, publication or render claim.
usage.inputs: output_path/title/body_html；locale 可选。使用已转义 Markdown 或可信作者 HTML，保留实际结论与离线交互，不为套模板编造图表或数据。
usage.outputs: {path,bytes,runtime,runtimeRevision,editable:true}；共享报告样式的工作区 HTML，尚未发布或渲染验收。
prerequisites: workspace 可写；已有真实报告正文。
limitations: 不清洗或执行作者脚本，不证明交互/导出成功。发布与 report_check 分别完成固定引用与渲染验收；静态导出另用 report_export_check。

capabilities.description: Create an editable Strategy report with the graph derived from an exact SVL source, a symbol/timeframe heatmap of preselected optimization winners, all-trial inspection and parameter sensitivity charts. Read report-writing/backtest.md for frozen row fields and selection rules. This renders results; it never runs or optimizes a strategy.

data_id.description: Fixed report data binding containing all trials; see backtest.md

selection_rule.description: Prespecified optimization objective, sample, constraints and tie-break; selected rows must already be recorded upstream

source_note.description: Engine, data range, sample split, costs, currency, metric definitions and limitations

currency.description: One common profit currency for these rows; split different currencies into separate comparisons

usage.purpose: Create an editable Strategy report with the graph derived from an exact SVL source, a symbol/timeframe heatmap of preselected optimization winners, all-trial inspection and parameter sensitivity charts. Read report-writing/backtest.md for frozen row fields and selection rules. This renders results; it never runs or optimizes a strategy.
usage.inputs: output_path/title/summary/strategy_source/data_id/parameters/selection_metric/selection_rule/source_note 描述已计算优化结果；strategy_source 是固定 SVL 引用。行字段见 report-writing/backtest.md。
usage.outputs: 已写入的可编辑 Strategy 报告 HTML 路径、字节数与绑定信息；图来自同一 SVL，网格和参数检查来自绑定数据。
prerequisites: workspace 可用；已发布策略源及有选优标记的固定回测结果。
limitations: 不运行策略或重新选优；缺失的样本外统计需由计算能力产生，不能用模板补造。

capabilities.description: List fixed report artifact revisions or read an exact report reference, including its pinned data and related evidence.

usage.purpose: List fixed report artifact revisions or read an exact report reference, including its pinned data and related evidence.
usage.inputs: 无 ref 分页列出 report 成果（limit 默认30）；有 ref 读该固定版本，include_checks=true 同时读取渲染回执。
usage.outputs: 列表为 {items,nextCursor?}；单项为资源 metadata、manifest 和可选 checks。
limitations: 旧 revision 的 rendered 只证明旧版本；未完成/未检查报告不冒充已验证成果。

capabilities.description: Render an exact published report revision through the host inspector. Return the persisted actual rendering receipt, viewport checks and diagnostics. Repair failed HTML as a new revision and inspect it again.

usage.purpose: Render an exact published report revision through the host inspector. Return the persisted actual rendering receipt, viewport checks and diagnostics. Repair failed HTML as a new revision and inspect it again.
usage.inputs: ref 为 report_publish 返回的完整固定 report ArtifactRef。
usage.outputs: 宿主真实渲染检查回执，含状态、视口/运行时检查和 diagnostics，并保存到该版本 receipts。
prerequisites: 宿主报告渲染器可用；已发布该 ref。
limitations: rendered 才证明本次检查通过；失败根据具体诊断修 HTML/数据，发布新 revision 再检查。无渲染器时明确未验证。
rendered 不等于可导出；receipt.exportability 是源级建议，真实静态准备检查另用 report_export_check。

capabilities.description: Preflight PDF and PNG for an exact published report revision without creating output files. Return supported formats and actionable reasons. Interactive publication/render success is independent; preflight does not verify final exported bytes or guarantee identical later output.

usage.purpose: Preflight PDF and PNG for an exact published report revision without creating output files. Return supported formats and actionable reasons. Interactive publication/render success is independent; preflight does not verify final exported bytes or guarantee identical later output.
usage.inputs: ref 为完整固定 report ArtifactRef；不按标题猜版本。
usage.outputs: {checked:"rendered-preflight",outputVerified:false,supportedFormats,formats,limits,binding}；每格式含 status/reasons；不返回 PDF/PNG 字节，不保存 rendered 验收回执。
prerequisites: 宿主报告渲染器及 report-export 检查接口可用。
limitations: 最终导出仍会检查内容/尺寸/32 MiB 预算；检查后的运行时状态可能不同。PDF 拒绝 shadow DOM、音视频/动画 SVG、不能忠实复制的字体/画布/资源。PNG 只保存静态视图，不保留交互。不能为通过导出而静默删掉证据或媒体。

capabilities.description: Publish Agent-authored HTML and packaged assets as an immutable report/1 artifact. All data and related artifacts are fixed references; report code gets only the read-only bridge. Publication does not claim successful rendering. Source exportability advice is advisory only; use report_export_check for runtime PDF/PNG preflight.

operation_id.description: Stable idempotency key for this exact report

locale.description: BCP 47 language, for example en or zh-CN

id.description: Local data binding ID used by report.readData

path.description: Safe relative path used by the HTML

artifact_id.description: Existing report artifact ID for a new revision

space.description: Initial destination for a new unbound report: strategy for strategy design, factor combinations, backtests and optimization; research for market, macro and source research. An existing report location or bound task output takes precedence. Does not require an SVL strategy source.

usage.purpose: Publish Agent-authored HTML and packaged assets as an immutable report/1 artifact. All data and related artifacts are fixed references; report code gets only the read-only bridge. Publication does not claim successful rendering. Source exportability advice is advisory only; use report_export_check for runtime PDF/PNG preflight.
usage.inputs: operation_id/title/summary/html_path/provenance_kind/data 必填；data=[{id,ref,...}] 将 HTML 的 bindingId 对应完整 DataRef。assets 打包本地资源；已有报告更新提供 artifact_id+expected_revision；strategy_source 将策略报告关联 SVL。 新报告用 space 明确分类：策略设计、因子组合、回测与优化为 strategy，市场/宏观/资料研究为 research；已有任务绑定和报告位置优先。仅真实 SVL 回测填写 strategy_source，原生/Python 回测无须为归类制造策略引用。
usage.outputs: {ref,title,data,runtime,runtimeRevision,renderStatus:"not_checked",exportability}；不可变报告已发布；exportability.checked="source" 只给格式候选/限制，不证明渲染或导出成功。
prerequisites: workspace 可读；所有引用已发布；HTML≤1MiB、打包总量≤16MiB；报告 API 与模板见公开 skills。
limitations: 同一 operation_id 对应同一固定内容；修改后用新 ID 和当前 revision。资源须打包，demo 输入必须保持 demo；渲染验收使用 report_check(ref)。
可交互发布与静态导出能力不同；不支持 PDF 的有效交互报告仍可发布。需要静态交付时用 report_export_check 检查该固定 ref，不自动生成 PDF，也不静默展平媒体。

knowledge.description: 报告职责、证据、真实交付与统一视觉验收原则；详细设计参数按需读取。
选统一模板与现成图表，核对主题和语义色，检查当前发布修订的实际渲染及视觉一致性。
共享样式的纯正文报告模板，不需要占位图表或数据
reportKit 页面骨架、outline 与图表参数、明细联动、规模限制、资源释放和本地化。
